Name: Squishychub Junimo
Author: saioume
Description:
Have been playing Little Witch in the Woods (by ﻿Sunny Side Up) obsessively recently and thought it would be cute to try to replace the junimos here with Squishychubs from the game. The colors will be consistent with vanilla junimo colors and shading. 
This is my very first mod so please be kind.

How to install:
﻿1. Download and install SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. Download ONE file between the main file or the optional one (adds the tails to the squishychubs which I originally forgot)
3. Unzip the chosen file and add it in the StardewValley/Mods folder
3. It should work! 

Featured in the images are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]Earthy Interiors[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url] mods.
